title: AnalyticsVizViewDef - Data API
description: Represents a Tableau Next viusalization view definition. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: The API name of the visualization view definition.

IsOriginal.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsOriginal.description: Indicates whether the view definition is original (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The supported languages for the visualization view definition. Possible values are: da—Danish de—German en_US—English es—Spanish es_MX—Spanish (Mexico) fi—Finnish fr—French it—Italian ja—Japanese ko—Korean nl_NL—Dutch no—Norwegian pt_BR—Portuguese (Brazil) ru—Russian sv—Swedish th—Thai zh_CN—Chinese (Simplified) zh_TW—Chinese (Traditional)

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: The label for the visualization view definition.

NamespacePrefix.description: The namespace prefix for the visualization view definition.

OwnerId.description: The user ID of the user who created the visualization view definition. This field is a relationship field.

Version.description: The API version for the visualization view definition.

VisualizationId.description: This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have Tableau Next enabled in your org and a Tableau Next permission set.

Version.field_label: Analytics Visualization View Definition API Version
